title: Permissions & Prohibitions: szabad, tilos, nem szabad

sections.title: Stating health prohibitions and permissions
sections.content: *Szabad* indicates permission ('is allowed'), while *tilos* or *nem szabad* indicates strict prohibition ('forbidden / not permitted'). Both govern the infinitive.

items.spanish: A kórházban szigorúan tilos a dohányzás.
items.english: In the hospital, smoking is strictly forbidden.

items.spanish: Gyógyszerszedés mellett nem szabad alkoholt fogyasztani.
items.english: Along with taking medication, it is not permitted to consume alcohol.

items.spanish: Lázas állapotban szabad sokat pihenni és aludni.
items.english: In a feverish state, one is permitted (and advised) to rest and sleep a lot.
